description: OpenClaw gateway activity, model requests, tokens, tool failures, messaging outcomes, and liveness. Compatible with classic and native OTLP Application Insights via their resource-scoped query views. All queries are restricted to openclaw-gateway. Request token totals exclude aggregate usage reports and harness turns; coverage shows missing usage.

panels.description: Recorded message-processing spans, including cron jobs. Failures use the explicit outcome or failed span status. Processing duration includes full agent work and is not time to first byte. Chat count is omitted because this telemetry does not include chat IDs.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
// Application Insights compatibility view: classic and native OTLP.
// Convert numeric attributes explicitly: classic exports strings, OTLP preserves numbers.
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "openclaw-gateway" or tostring(column_ifexists("serviceName", "")) == "openclaw-gateway"
| where name == "openclaw.message.processed"
| extend channel = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["openclaw.channel"]), "unknown"),
         outcome = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["openclaw.outcome"]), "unknown")
| extend failed = outcome in~ ("error", "failed", "failure") or tobool(success) == false
| summarize ['Messages'] = count(), ['Failed Messages'] = countif(failed), ['Avg Processing Time'] = avg(duration) / 1000.0, ['P95 Processing Time'] = percentile(duration, 95) / 1000.0

panels.title: Message Summary

panels.description: One openclaw.model.call request span per observation; harness turns are excluded. Tokens sum only request spans with valid input/output usage. See Usage Coverage for missing reports; aggregate openclaw.model.usage events are not added to request tokens.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
// Application Insights compatibility view: classic and native OTLP.
// Convert numeric attributes explicitly: classic exports strings, OTLP preserves numbers.
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "openclaw-gateway" or tostring(column_ifexists("serviceName", "")) == "openclaw-gateway"
| where name == "openclaw.model.call"
| extend a = customDimensions
| where tostring(a["openclaw.model_call.observation_unit"]) != "turn" and tostring(a["gen_ai.operation.name"]) != "invoke_agent"
| extend model = coalesce(tostring(a["openclaw.model"]), tostring(a["gen_ai.request.model"]), "unknown"),
         provider = coalesce(tostring(a["openclaw.provider"]), tostring(a["gen_ai.provider.name"]), tostring(a["gen_ai.system"]), "unknown"),
         input_tokens = coalesce(todouble(a["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]), todouble(a["openclaw.model_call.usage.prompt_tokens"])),
         output_tokens = coalesce(todouble(a["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]), todouble(a["openclaw.model_call.usage.output_tokens"])),
         cached_tokens = coalesce(todouble(a["gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens"]), todouble(a["openclaw.model_call.usage.cache_read_input_tokens"]), 0.0),
         cache_write_tokens = coalesce(todouble(a["gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens"]), todouble(a["openclaw.model_call.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens"]), 0.0)

| extend ['Output Tokens']=iff(covered > 0, ['Output Tokens'],real(null)), ['Cached Input Tokens']=iff(covered > 0, ['Cached Input Tokens'],real(null))

panels.description: Disjoint token categories from model request spans with valid usage. Input tokens include cached and cache-write tokens, so both are subtracted from uncached input. Missing usage is excluded; see Usage Coverage. Aggregate run usage is not mixed in.

dependencies

| where cloud_RoleName == "openclaw-gateway" or tostring(column_ifexists("serviceName", "")) == "openclaw-gateway"
| where name == "openclaw.model.call"
| extend a = customDimensions
| where tostring(a["openclaw.model_call.observation_unit"]) != "turn" and tostring(a["gen_ai.operation.name"]) != "invoke_agent"

         input_tokens = coalesce(todouble(a["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]), todouble(a["openclaw.model_call.usage.prompt_tokens"])),
         output_tokens = coalesce(todouble(a["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]), todouble(a["openclaw.model_call.usage.output_tokens"])),
         cached_tokens = coalesce(todouble(a["gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens"]), todouble(a["openclaw.model_call.usage.cache_read_input_tokens"]), 0.0),

panels.description: Latest 100 warning/error records for OpenClaw only. Uses exported structured error/reason fields when the log body is only 'log'. 'Message text not exported' marks an upstream telemetry gap; it is not synthesized error text. No raw chat content or tool arguments are queried.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
traces
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "openclaw-gateway" or tostring(column_ifexists("serviceName", "")) == "openclaw-gateway"
| extend a=customDimensions
| extend level=toupper(coalesce(tostring(a["openclaw.log.level"]),case(severityLevel>=3,"ERROR",severityLevel==2,"WARN",""))),
         subsystem=coalesce(tostring(a["openclaw.subsystem"]),tostring(a["openclaw.module"]),tostring(a["openclaw.logger"]),"unknown")
| where level in ("ERROR","WARN","FATAL","WARNING")
| extend level=case(level=="WARNING","WARN",level=="FATAL","ERROR",level)
| extend details=coalesce(tostring(a["openclaw.error"]),tostring(a["openclaw.reason"]),tostring(a["openclaw.watchdogReason"]),iff(message != "log", message, ""))
| extend details=coalesce(details,"Message text not exported"), source=tostring(a["code.function"]), silence_min=todouble(a["openclaw.minutesSinceLastMessage"])
| project timestamp,level,subsystem,details=substring(details,0,600),source,silence_min,TraceId=operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
| take 100

panels.title: Shell Exec Outcomes

panels.description: Valid positive heap/RSS observations from custom metrics or memory-pressure spans. Zero heap/RSS samples are invalid and omitted. Gaps mean no valid observations; native ingestion may not expose these custom metrics. This is not a continuous availability signal.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union
(customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "openclaw-gateway" or tostring(column_ifexists("serviceName", "")) == "openclaw-gateway"
| where name in ("openclaw.memory.heap_used_bytes","openclaw.memory.rss_bytes")
| project timestamp, metric=iff(name=="openclaw.memory.heap_used_bytes","Heap","RSS"), bytes=todouble(value)),
(// Application Insights compatibility view: classic and native OTLP.
// Convert numeric attributes explicitly: classic exports strings, OTLP preserves numbers.
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "openclaw-gateway" or tostring(column_ifexists("serviceName", "")) == "openclaw-gateway"
| where name == "openclaw.memory.pressure"
| project timestamp, samples=pack_array(bag_pack("metric","Heap","bytes",todouble(customDimensions["openclaw.memory.heap_used_bytes"])),bag_pack("metric","RSS","bytes",todouble(customDimensions["openclaw.memory.rss_bytes"])))
| mv-expand samples
| project timestamp,metric=tostring(samples.metric),bytes=todouble(samples.bytes))
| where bytes > 0
| summarize bytes=avg(bytes) by bin(timestamp,$__interval),metric

panels.description: Success/failure status for model request spans. Harness turn observations are excluded.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
// Application Insights compatibility view: classic and native OTLP.
// Convert numeric attributes explicitly: classic exports strings, OTLP preserves numbers.
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "openclaw-gateway" or tostring(column_ifexists("serviceName", "")) == "openclaw-gateway"
| where name == "openclaw.model.call"
| extend a = customDimensions
| where tostring(a["openclaw.model_call.observation_unit"]) != "turn" and tostring(a["gen_ai.operation.name"]) != "invoke_agent"
| extend model = coalesce(tostring(a["openclaw.model"]), tostring(a["gen_ai.request.model"]), "unknown"),
         provider = coalesce(tostring(a["openclaw.provider"]), tostring(a["gen_ai.provider.name"]), tostring(a["gen_ai.system"]), "unknown"),
         input_tokens = coalesce(todouble(a["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]), todouble(a["openclaw.model_call.usage.prompt_tokens"])),
         output_tokens = coalesce(todouble(a["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]), todouble(a["openclaw.model_call.usage.output_tokens"])),
         cached_tokens = coalesce(todouble(a["gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens"]), todouble(a["openclaw.model_call.usage.cache_read_input_tokens"]), 0.0),
         cache_write_tokens = coalesce(todouble(a["gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens"]), todouble(a["openclaw.model_call.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens"]), 0.0)
| extend has_usage = isnotnull(input_tokens) and isnotnull(output_tokens) and input_tokens >= 0 and output_tokens >= 0 and cached_tokens >= 0 and cache_write_tokens >= 0 and cached_tokens + cache_write_tokens <= input_tokens
| extend outcome=case(tobool(success)==false,"failure",tobool(success)==true,"success","unknown")
| summarize requests=count() by bin(timestamp,$__interval),outcome
| order by timestamp asc

panels.description: Latest 100 failed/aborted OpenClaw operations and stuck-session events. Session age comes from openclaw.ageMs; zero-duration detector spans are not used as the stuck duration.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
// Application Insights compatibility view: classic and native OTLP.
// Convert numeric attributes explicitly: classic exports strings, OTLP preserves numbers.
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "openclaw-gateway" or tostring(column_ifexists("serviceName", "")) == "openclaw-gateway"
| where name startswith "openclaw."
| extend a=customDimensions,outcome=tolower(tostring(customDimensions["openclaw.outcome"]))

| order by timestamp desc
| take 100
